content.title: Justin Bieber And His Wife Hailey Quietly Splurge On $7M Idaho Home To Get Away From LA Life
content.text: Justin Bieber has quietly purchased a $7M lakeside home in Idaho, offering privacy and relaxation away from Los Angeles.According to a report, the singer enjoys golf, shopping, and time on the water without fanfare alongside his wife, Hailey Bieber.Last month, Justin Bieber stunned fans as he released "Swag," his first album since 2021, featuring son Jack on the cover.Justin Bieber's Hidden $7M Idaho Lakeside RetreatInstagram | Justin BieberThe U.S. Sun has revealed that Justin Bieber has quietly splurged on a lakeside home in Idaho, now valued at $7 million.While the 31-year-old singer and his wife, Hailey, 28, primarily live in Los Angeles with their son, they often escape the Hollywood spotlight by spending time at Lake Coeur d'Alene in Kootenai County.The couple has been spotted vacationing in the area, with Justin sharing photos and videos from their trips.Though it was previously believed Justin rented homes nearby, records now confirm he bought a custom-built residence near Gozzer Ranch Golf & Lake Club back in 2020.The nearly 5,000-square-foot property features five bedrooms and five and a half bathrooms. Inside, the open-concept design connects the kitchen to the dining space, complete with high-end appliances.Outside, the home offers excellent entertaining options, including a covered patio, barbecue setup, and a cozy fire pit.Inside The Singer's Idaho Getaway Where He Escapes Fame For Golf And Lake Dayszz/XNY/starmaxinc.com/Newscom/MEGAJustin purchased the property for $4.2 million in mid-2020 through an LLC connected to Tri Star Sports and Entertainment Group, a company he has since left.More in CelebrityA local source told The U.S. Sun, "Justin has been coming to Coeur d'Alene for years. He can be out on the water and hang out at the Gozzer ranch club without being disturbed every day, and have people taking photographs of everything he does; he can relax more."They continued: "He's often playing golf and hanging with friends, just being a normal guy and not a pop star. Justin has even been seen downtown browsing around the local shops, but people tend to leave him alone.""They are very protective here, and it's not unusual to see stars. This is a place where celebrities come to get away and can switch off, and it's packed with natural beauty," the source concluded.Justin Bieber Shared A Heartfelt Instagram Tribute To Hailey With Romantic Summer MomentsRecently, Justin took to Instagram to post a sweet tribute to Hailey, sharing a carousel of romantic snapshots and late-summer memories.The first photo was an intimate close-up of the couple, with the Rhode founder leaning her head against Justin's shoulder and tucking a yellow flower behind her ear.The singer kept his look casual in a white tank top and a gold chain necklace from Brilliant Earth.Another shot captured the pair sharing a kiss, their faces hidden from view, followed by photos of them enjoying an outdoor picnic in the same outfits.Hailey wore a classic white T-shirt with dark-wash jeans, while Justin sported a neon yellow sweatshirt and jorts decorated with studded leather patches.He finished off the laid-back ensemble with white ankle socks and bold magenta slides from his new streetwear brand, Skylrk.The Singer Dropped His 7th Studio Album, 'Swag'Thecelebrityfinder/MEGALast month, Justin surprised fans with the release of his seventh studio album, "Swag," featuring his young son on the cover.This is his first album since 2021's "Justice" and has been met with strong acclaim."Swag" is a deeply intimate project that delves into Justin's personal battles, particularly the difficulties of coping with fame under the public eye.The album's cover shows a shirtless and heavily tattooed Justin lounging on a sofa while playfully holding baby Jack upside down by his legs.Justin Bieber Opens Up About Fame, Mental Health, And Fatherhood In 'Swag'MEGAIn the song "Therapy Session," from his new album, Justin candidly discusses his mental health struggles, sharing how openly facing his challenges has been exhausting.He said, "That's been a tough thing for me recently, is feeling like I've had to go through a lot of my struggles as a human really publicly, so people are always asking if I'm ok, and that starts to really weigh on me."Justin continued: "It starts to make me feel like I'm the only one with issues and everyone else is perfect."The singer credits his Christian faith and wife, Hailey, for supporting him through dark times and often turns to music as his form of therapy.
